info.title: PoracleNG API
info.x-fixture-source: jfberry/PoracleNG fa2836719 (PR #328) processor/internal/api/testdata/openapi.golden.json, trimmed to the maxbattle tracking POST. The golden file itself reports version 'test'.

post.description: Body is an array of strict rule objects. Returns {created,updated,unchanged} (POST keeps the diff/upsert behaviour). With ?include_descriptions=true each rule gains a description. ?silent=true suppresses the confirmation push.

parameters.description: Human id (the owning user); ownership scope for every rule
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Profile number; defaults to the human's active profile
parameters.name: profile

parameters.description: Add a human-readable description to each rule in the response

parameters.description: Apply without sending the confirmation push

parameters.description: Allow override_areas to name fences that are not userSelectable, for a client that has already authorised the change. Unknown fence names are still rejected; area_security community restrictions still apply.

parameters.description: Validate and classify without writing: returns what would be created/updated/unchanged (created rules have uid 0, updated rules carry previous), with dry_run:true. Nothing is stored, reloaded or pushed. The preview is advisory; a later commit reports what it actually did.
